verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents its own reconciliation report suite, including a Payouts Report, a Financial Actions by Payout ID Report and a Settlement Breakdown Report, which maps each payout to its underlying financial actions. The evidence does not show these reports or balance-transaction data can be pulled programmatically through the API. The documented MCP server covers payment status, refunds, voids and payment links, not payout or financial-report data. missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for retrieving payouts and financial actions, agent/MCP access to reconciliation data, hands-on corroboration of per-deposit matching to charges

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges

citations.quote: Balance Breakdown Report, Balance Report, Financial Actions by Date Range Report, Financial Actions by Payout ID Report, Payouts Report, Settlement Breakdown Report, Settlement Statement
